records.name: PDF Accessibility Checker by WebYes
records.tagline: Find PDF accessibility issues for free, with fix guidance
records.description: Find issues that can make your PDFs difficult for people with disabilities to read or use, including missing image descriptions and problems with headings. See affected content highlighted on the page, review issues by severity, and get instructions on how to fix them. The checker also flags what needs human review. Upload PDFs up to 50 MB or paste a public link. Completely free, with no sign-up, no email required, and no files stored. Checks against WCAG 2.1 AA and PDF/UA.

records.name: Loqui
records.tagline: Turns your voice into ready-to-send text in any Mac app
records.description: Loqui turns your voice into clean, ready-to-send text in any app on your Mac. Hold a shortcut, speak, and the text lands at your cursor in the tone you pick. It also transcribes meetings and writes the minutes. 90+ languages. Free plan, no card needed.

records.name: AI Bridge
records.tagline: Every AI coding agent on your Mac, in its place
records.description: AI Bridge runs Claude Code, Codex, Grok and OpenCode side by side on your Mac: each the real CLI in a real terminal, on your own subscription. Group your agents like a team, by department or by what each one owns. Open a Kubernetes cluster or talk to your database in plain words, right beside them. Prefer terminals? The Grid puts them all on one wall, with cluster and database chats where you need them. Open as many windows as you like, and put agents in Slack that reply when you approve.

records.name: omerta
records.tagline: Catch .env secrets leaking into git
records.description: Catchenv secrets leaking into git: a pre-commit hook and CLI that fails when an API key or any value of your env files is staged, tracked or anywhere in the history. Your real values, not patterns.

records.name: tabsh
records.tagline: Work with agents with an IDE in your browser tab
records.description: Most ADEs bring the browser into the IDE. tabsh takes the opposite approach: bring coding sessions to your browser, where your work already happens. It's a small Rust daemon that puts all your sessions across projects on one Kanban board/list, with status updates via agent hooks. Use real terminals or chat panels with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, and more. Free, MIT-licensed, macOS/Linux.

records.name: ManyAgents
records.tagline: Run a team of AI coding agents from one Mac window
records.description: An orchestrator splits your work across Claude Code and Codex agents, each in its own git worktree. A reviewer checks the result, a built-in browser lets agents test their own work, and every question lands in one place. Uses the plans you already have. Free for 14 days.

records.name: Flipcorder
records.tagline: A 1991 camcorder for your iPhone, one tape a day
records.description: Currently #3 in Top Paid Photo & Video on the US App Store 🎉 Flipcorder turns your iPhone into a 1991 camcorder. We have lost touch crafting perfect videos for social media, and Flipcorder encourages you to take shorter "flips" of 20 seconds each throughout your day to enjoy as a home video at the end of the day. No editing, just shoot and enjoy in VHS or DV style. Made for iPhone Duo, works on any iPhone. $4.99 once. No ads, no subscription, no watermark, no account.

records.name: Kiwi
records.tagline: A proactive AI assistant that texts you before you ask
records.description: Kiwi is your proactive assistant. It keeps track of what's coming up, your trips, plans, bills and the people in them, and texts you at the right moment. When something needs doing, it does it on any app or website when you say yes. Your Saturday is free: want a plan with the kids? Your flight is delayed: want a car for when you land? Your parcel needs a signature while you're at work: move it to Saturday? It all happens in iMessage or WhatsApp. Free during the pilot.

records.name: WhoIsCooking
records.tagline: See which AI agent is heating your Mac and cool it down.
records.description: A Mac app that shows chip temperature and which AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) is heating your Apple Silicon Mac. One click moves busy work to the efficiency cores, so everything keeps running, cooler. $5 one time.

records.name: CloudKnife
records.tagline: Cut your cloud bill, not your performance
records.description: Cloud cost tools tell you what to cut, then leave the work to you. CloudKnife handles it from A to Z. AI agents learn what every Azure resource is, how it’s really used and what it’s allowed to become. A deterministic core checks every recommendation against hard rules, so your SAP VM only gets SAP-certified options. You approve, CloudKnife executes. Your cloud stays lean and your team gets its time back for innovation.

records.name: 2G
records.tagline: Sampler to create early 2000 Neural Synthesis
records.description: 2G is a sampler that looks and sounds like an early-2000s handheld devices. We imagined what Neural Synthesis would have been like back then. Describe a sound and 2G makes it. Then edit it and play it from your computer keyboard, or load your own audio instead. 2G is free for Windows and macOS, as a plugin or a standalone app, and starts you with 20 credits for generating sounds. Studio ($10/month, 7-day trial) gives you 200 credits a month.

records.name: N8N Chat UI
records.tagline: Beautiful, no-code, on-brand AI chat widgets for n8n
records.description: N8N Chat UI is a no-code builder for branded AI chat widgets, built for n8n users, agencies, SaaS teams, and businesses. Design a mobile-friendly chat experience with live preview, then connect it to any n8n workflow and embed it anywhere. Unlike default n8n chat, it adds deep customization, streaming, voice and file uploads, flexible layouts, and a JavaScript API for advanced integrations.

records.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
records.tagline: MiniMax’s Flash model, 3x faster and 70% cheaper for agents
records.description: MiniMax M3.1 Flash is MiniMax’s new Flash model for agentic tasks, coding, computer use and cybersecurity. MiniMax says it is about 3x faster online and 70% cheaper for agentic tasks than its predecessor, with output at 200+ tokens per second. Pricing is $0.15 input and $0.60 output per 1M tokens. It’s on the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code, and weights are promised later.

records.name: SurgePix
records.tagline: AI visuals. Edit every layer. Agent-callable.
records.description: Most AI image tools stop at one-shot generation. SurgePix keeps going: edit any layer, swap text, repaint a region, and stay on-brand with your brand kit. Or skip the UI — open-source agent skills let Claude Code & Cursor generate and edit visuals for you.

records.name: Strawberry 1.0
records.tagline: AI Browser that saves your team >100h/week
records.description: Strawberry is an AI browser that can do hours of work in minutes. Strawberry's agents, which we call "Companions", can research hundreds of leads in parallel, transcribe your meetings, automate follow-ups, and handle all the repetitive admin your team keeps procrastinating. Create or hire a pre-made companion, teach it your preferences and share it with your whole team. Hundreds of teams, including Lovable, Tandem Health and ElevenLabs, already use Strawberry.

records.name: VibeiDE
records.tagline: Queue agent tasks in parallel and review each result
records.description: Queue Codex and Claude Code tasks across your projects, run them in parallel and review every result. Built for developers and solo founders.

records.name: desigma
records.tagline: Free Figma alternative made on Rust
records.description: Free Figma alternative made on Rust. Contribute to deepfounder-ai/desigma development by creating an account on GitHub.

records.name: Standfast
records.tagline: Know if your Mac's GitHub Actions runners will get work
records.description: A free macOS menu bar app for self-hosted GitHub Actions runners. It asks launchd whether each runner is alive and GitHub whether it still counts on it, and never mixes up the two answers.

records.name: Knock
records.tagline: Create shortcuts by hitting your mac
records.description: Knock is a shortcut app that lets you control your Mac by simply knocking on it. Tap the sides of your laptop and it runs any shortcut you want — screenshot, open apps, mute sound, and more. It uses your Mac's built-in accelerometer to actually feel the vibration of your knock and react in real time, no extra hardware needed - just knock and go.

records.name: Helio
records.tagline: Know exactly what your rooftop solar made today
records.description: Rooftop solar apps make you dig for the one number you want: units made today. Helio opens straight on it, read from your inverter's own energy counter via ShineMonitor / SmartClient. Also: live power, any past day as a 5-minute curve, 30-day, yearly and lifetime history, and savings in your own currency and tariff. Deploy your own copy to Vercel in 5 minutes. Free, MIT licensed, no database, no tracking. Your login never reaches the browser.

records.name: Mozy
records.tagline: App Blocker for Android & iPhone
records.description: An app blocker and step counter: walking earns screen-time minutes for the apps you pick, and those apps lock when the minutes run out.

records.name: AllModels
records.tagline: Explore every abliterated model
records.description: Route abliterated language models across providers with automatic fallbacks, modality-aware selection, and one place to compare availability and token prices.

records.name: AVP
records.tagline: Open source alternative to Git for AI coding agents
records.description: Worktrees isolate your agents. AVP integrates them: every change proven on the exact head of main before it lands.

records.name: Jobmate AI
records.tagline: The humanized AI Copilot for your entire Job search
records.description: Jobmate AI takes the busywork of job hunting off your plate so your energy goes into landing interviews. An AI agent auto-applies for you, autofills any application form from your profile and answers the open-ended questions. Find fresh roles from across the web, tailor your resume and cover letter to each one, reach the recruiters and hiring managers behind it, and track every application and interview in one place. Free to start on Chrome and Firefox.

records.name: Duelo de características

records.name: Copy4Paste
records.tagline: Copy, choose, paste — a tiny clipboard picker for Mac
records.description: Copy4Paste turns ⌘V into a tiny picker for your recent copies. Choose text with a number key and keep working. Free, native and open-source for macOS, with no accounts, cloud or tracking. Includes customizable community skins.

records.name: NO-AI-ACT: Outbreak Strategy
records.tagline: Lead an AI campaign across a connected Europe
records.description: Lead a fictional AI campaign across 27 connected European countries. Choose Singularity or Corporation, develop your AI and counter changing threats. Includes 48 developments, three difficulty levels, six scenarios, offline play, local saves and six interface languages. Free, with no ads or in-app purchases.

records.name: ClipGum
records.tagline: The private macOS clipboard that cleans every paste
records.description: Traditional clipboard managers log everything you copy, risking leaked credentials and tokens. ClipGum is an open-source, zero-cloud privacy utility for macOS: • Auto-strips tracking tokens (UTM, fbclid) on copy • Redacts API keys & secrets deterministically • Runs on-device Apple MLX AI for text polish & table-to-Markdown • Fast cursor radial wheel (⌃X) • Zero persistent history

records.name: TrackFit - Workout Tracker
records.tagline: Train. Track. Improve.
records.description: TrackFit is a simple, mobile-first workout tracker featuring customizable plans, 1,300+ exercises with videos, automatic rest timers, vibration alerts, cardio tracking, and detailed progress statistics. Unlike traditional workout logs, it combines fast in-gym logging, flexible planning, ready-made routines, personal records, and social sharing in one app. Free to use, with an optional PRO subscription for an ad-free experience and unlimited plans.

records.name: Paraksa
records.tagline: Indian Social Media
records.description: Paraksa is a modern social networking platform that helps you connect with friends, share photos and videos, chat in real time, and discover communities. Create posts, engage with content, and enjoy a fast, secure, and intuitive social experience. Features: Share photos, videos, and posts Real-time messaging Personalized home feed User profiles Notifications Smooth and secure experience We continuously improve Paraksa with new features, bug fixes, and performance enhancements.

records.name: GlideMix
records.tagline: Mixtape Studio
records.description: Build DJ mixes on a timeline. Every transition perfect, every beat in place. GlideMix is a DJ mixing studio for mixtapes, radio shows and DJ sets: lay your songs out like in a DAW, the MixMeister way, and shape every blend at your own pace.

records.name: YEON
records.tagline: Seoul & Busan the way Koreans actually go
records.description: I'm a Korean developer and I built this alone. YEON is a free guide to Seoul and Busan built around the places Koreans actually go to eat, not the usual tourist lists. It also covers what I always wish visitors knew: where the public toilets are, what exhibitions and pop-ups are on right now, and what's open at this hour. Every place has its Korean name and address. Free, no ads, no sign-up.

records.name: NextTransit
records.tagline: See the next train at your stops
records.description: NextTransit shows the next train arriving at your preferred stops — minimal input, live predictions where the agency provides them and the published schedule otherwise. Free on iOS and Android.

records.name: tool4seller
records.tagline: All-in-one Amazon seller software for profit & PPC
records.description: tool4seller is an all-in-one Amazon seller platform by TAPCASH INC., serving sellers since 2017. It turns sales, fees, ad spend and inventory into per-SKU profit dashboards — profit & sales analytics, Amazon PPC optimization, product & keyword research, FBA inventory management and AI-assisted listing optimization, on web, iOS and Android, across 22 marketplaces. New: its MCP integration lets sellers query diagnostics, profit, advertising and inventory from AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude.

records.name: PodReel
records.tagline: Spend your time creating. Leave the clipping to us.
records.description: PodReel is an AI-powered podcast-to-short-form-clips pipeline. A user uploads a podcast video; the system stores it, transcribes it, uses an LLM to find "viral-worthy" moments, auto-reframes each clip around the active speaker, renders it with animated word-level captions and serves you a clean, ready-to-upload video file tailored for short-form platforms like TikTok, Instagram and YouTube shorts.

records.name: Shift Worker Calendar
records.tagline: Plan rotating shifts, see your year and get shift alarms
records.description: Shift Worker Calendar is built for nurses, factory crews, security teams and anyone on a rotation. Pick a pattern like 4-on-4-off, Pitman, DuPont, Continental, 24/48 or your own cycle, set its start day, and see your schedule in month, week or year view. Record swaps, leave and holidays without breaking the rotation, set alarms that ring only on working days, and log hours and overtime. No account needed.

records.name: ShieldPress
records.tagline: 24/7 Website, VPS & Server Monitoring & Security
records.description: ShieldPress is an all-in-one website, VPS, and server monitoring and security platform. Monitor uptime, SSL certificates, domains, and server performance 24/7 from a single dashboard. Get instant alerts when issues arise, detect potential threats, and stay ahead of downtime. Built for developers, agencies, and businesses, ShieldPress makes infrastructure monitoring simple, proactive, and reliable—so you can focus on building while we keep watch.

records.name: LieuTenant
records.tagline: free property management for UK landlords
records.description: Free landlord software for rent, certificates, repairs and tenants. No limit on homes. Set up for the Renters' Rights Act in England.

records.name: The 100% Free Solopreneur Tech Stack
records.tagline: Run a $10k/month digital business with $0 software overhead.
records.description: An interactive, open directory of 100% free software alternatives to run an online business without monthly subscription fees. Covers landing pages, forms, email marketing dashboards, invoice tracking, and operations tools with no hidden paywalls or email forms required. Built to duplicate straight into your workspace.

records.name: YouTube to MP3 Converter
records.tagline: Free YouTube to MP3 converter on video2mp3converter.org
records.description: Free YouTube to MP3 Converter. Paste a public link and save audio for personal, offline use.

records.name: Karma Space
records.tagline: Scan your home. Explore its Feng Shui.
records.description: Karma Space brings home scanning and traditional Feng Shui into one visual workflow. Capture rooms with LiDAR on supported iPhones, or upload or draw a floor plan without LiDAR. Explore 3D layouts, compass directions and Flying Stars, with AI explanations to help you understand the results. Built in Hong Kong for people exploring their homes and furniture placement. Free to download, with optional paid features.

records.name: Meme Video AI
records.tagline: Hit the Road Dude Meme AI Video
records.description: Meme Video AI is a Hit the Road Dude AI video generator: upload one photo of your cat, dog, toy or a character you drew and it becomes the grumpy pickup-truck driver from the Hit the Road Dude meme, also known as the Lock 'Em Up meme. You get a 10 or 15 second vertical MP4 with sound, keeping the original pause and the "this is private property" punchline, ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. No prompt to write.

records.name: carafe
records.tagline: continuity layer for ai coding agents
records.description: Hand off work between coding agents: Claude Code to Codex, Codex to Devin, and more. Every session kept on your machine, searchable and replayable. Open source, local-first.

records.name: GameBox
records.tagline: Your Ultimate Hub for Fun & Games
records.description: GameBox is a fun and easy-to-use gaming app that brings exciting games and entertainment together in one place. 🎮 Play different games with a smooth and engaging experience, take on fun challenges, earn rewards, and convert eligible rewards into real money. 💰 🎮 Multiple games ⚡ Smooth gameplay 🏆 Fun challenges 💰 Earn rewards 💵 Real-money conversion 📱 Casual gaming Play. Earn. Have fun! 🔥

records.name: pointapointb
records.tagline: AI-powered self-discovery.
records.description: A private space to see your life, from where you are to where you want to be.

records.name: Tellyscope
records.tagline: Free your TV from unwanted trackings and bloats.
records.description: An open source app that cleans up your TV, turns off ads, trackers and bloat in a few taps from the community list of more than 300+ devices. Side load apps your TV's store doesn't carry, send files from your phone, and see which apps use data and where they connect. Free, GPL-3.0, Under 3MB, no ads, no tracking, no account.

records.name: Katazom.hu
records.tagline: Automated tax compliance & invoicing assistant
records.description: Running a sole proprietorship in Hungary comes with strict tax thresholds (strict invoicing rules, and severe 40% surcharges for threshold breaches). Connects directly to the Hungarian Tax Authority (NAV Online Számla 3.0 API) in real time to provide an automated safety net for entrepreneurs. • Real-time invoice synchronization directly from NAV. • Proactive limit alerts & pro-rata calculation for suspended months. • AI-assisted VAT anomaly detector and one-click corrective invoice formulas.

records.name: Orcus
records.tagline: No LLm api Credits Required with Orcus to make ai call
records.description: Orcus is the AI SDK. With Orcus, No LLM API key required to make AI model requests. Orcus uses your web credentials to access AI models available through supported provider websites and deliver responses to your applications through a familiar, API-style interface. From model invocation and streaming to structured outputs, tool calling, and batch processing, Orcus brings essential AI integration capabilities into one developer-friendly SDK.

records.name: Poof
records.tagline: Cross-platform AirDrop: Windows, Mac, Android, iPhone
records.description: AirDrop stops at Apple. Poof doesn't. Drop a file on your phone, it lands on your PC in seconds. Windows, Android, and any browser today — iPhone and Mac native apps on the way. No cable, no account, end-to-end encrypted. Free, or €6.99 lifetime for the first 100 buyers.

records.name: DogDynasty
records.tagline: Your dog has a social life too. Now, they have an app!
records.description: Built by a rescue dog mom who wanted to trace origins and just maybe find littermates and puppies! DogDynasty is the private social network for dogs. No phone numbers, no strangers, no endless feed. Park O'Clock: Alert your dog's friends when you're heading to the park. Fur Friends: Coordinate playdates without sharing your number. Family Finder: Trace your dog's origins and find relatives. Violet Alert: Post missing or found dog alerts instantly. First 100 members get free lifetime access.

records.name: Haptic Stage Timer
records.tagline: Silent Wear OS timer cues for talks and performances
records.description: Haptic Stage Timer is a silent stage timer for Wear OS. Build presets for talks, sets, lectures or rehearsals, add milestone cues, and feel quiet haptic signals on your wrist instead of checking a clock. Confidence Mode dims the view, Stage Lock blocks accidental taps, and overtime tracking shows if you run long. Runs on the watch alone, offline, with no account or server. Pro is a one-time upgrade for unlimited presets and milestones and the full haptic pattern library.

records.name: ScanFit
records.tagline: Instant gym machine identification & exercise setup guide
records.description: ScanFit eliminates gym friction—walking up to an unfamiliar machine and spending 10 minutes looking up setup guides online. Built as a guest-first web utility, upload or take a photo to instantly identify equipment using Gemini Vision AI. Get targeted muscle breakdowns, seat height adjustments, and form cues with zero signups or app downloads.

records.name: tidra.video
records.tagline: Tidra is a video generator that thinks like a camera crew
records.description: Tidra is a video generator that thinks like a camera crew. Text-to-video or image-to-video — Fast, Balanced, or Premium.

records.name: BlueDesk Voice
records.tagline: Offline voiceovers and voice cloning for Mac
records.description: Create voiceovers locally on your Mac. Use your own voice reference, keep reusable profiles, compare takes, and export WAV or MP3. A creator-focused workflow with a free trial and a one-time purchase. Voice quality and speed depend on your Mac and recording.

records.name: Elento Digital
records.tagline: Free AI stock photos, each with its generation prompt
records.description: Stock photos are expensive and never quite right. Elento Digital is a free library of AI-generated stock photos — every photo ships with the exact professional prompt used to create it. Copy it, tweak it, make it yours. Free for commercial use.

records.name: NoClutterCRM
records.tagline: AI sales CRM for WhatsApp, email and website chat
records.description: Turn scattered enquiries into organised sales conversations. NoClutterCRM connects WhatsApp, email and website chat with your contacts and pipeline. AI uses your business knowledge to answer questions and qualify leads, while your team manages handoffs and follow-ups. Try it free for 30 days—no credit card required.

records.name: Rimara Real Estate Suite
records.tagline: Property Listing Software for Agents & Brokers
records.description: Property listing software for real estate agents and brokers: a mobile API for adding listings with photos and video, a shareable web page for every property, and a curated public website.

records.name: Indexability Checker API
records.tagline: Why can't Google index this URL? One API call.
records.description: Checks meta robots, X-Robots-Tag, canonical and robots.txt in one call and returns whether a URL can be indexed by Google. If not, it names the declared signal that blocks it. Every finding has a stable code, the evidence it was based on and a Google Search Central link. GET /v1/check fetches live; POST /v1/validate works offline on drafts. It reads declared signals only and does not query Google's index.

records.name: WtsMyIP.com
records.tagline: Free IP & Network Tools
records.description: Check your IP address, validate IPv4 and IPv6, calculate subnets, convert IP formats, and explore useful network tools in one simple, easy-to-use platform. Copy description

records.description: GameAccountValue helps gamers estimate account values across 10 popular games, including PUBG Mobile, Roblox, Fortnite, and Genshin Impact. Unlike ordinary AI chatbots, it combines screenshot recognition, a proprietary database, market price parsing, and game-specific algorithms. Try the free online calculator or Telegram AI bot. Paid reports include an estimated value range, PDF certificate, and collectible card. No passwords required. Estimates are approximate.

records.name: Hacker New Tab

All local.

records.description: Darmowy planer szlaków w Tatrach. Działa także bez zasięgu.

records.description: Run a multi-agent AI team in the cloud: specialists that delegate, report back and run long missions. Sandboxed plugins, a 3D companion, no server.

records.name: Yardlet

records.description: Redesign your front yard, backyard, or boulevard with AI visualization and DIY landscaping tools. Explore plants and materials, estimate quantities, and get a step-by-step plan to bring your ideas to life.

records.name: WatchSyncer: TV & Movie tracker
records.tagline: Never lose your place in a show again
records.description: Started a new show and forgot where you left off the last one? WatchSyncer remembers your episode in every movie, show and anime, in one private library. It syncs your history with Trakt, SIMKL, AniList, TMDB, Jellyfin and more, alerts you the moment a new episode drops, and shows episode ratings and reviews with spoilers hidden. Search TMDB, IMDb and AniList in one place, and see what's returning or in production. No account, no ads, no tracking.

records.name: TuneStage: Guitar & Bass Tuner
records.tagline: Guitar & Bass Tuner
records.description: Want to tune your guitar or bass quickly and accurately? With TuneStage, getting in tune is simple. Whether you play electric guitar, acoustic guitar, or bass, TuneStage gives you a high-quality guitar tuner, chromatic tuner, and dozens of alternative tunings to get you ready to play in seconds. But TuneStage is more than just a guitar tuning app. It also includes a metronome, audio recorder, chord library, and guitar scales. Everything you need in one easy-to-use app.

records.name: GamifyTL
records.tagline: Live Quizzes, Classroom Games & Audience Polls
records.description: GamifyTL brings gamified, real-time teaching and learning to classrooms and workshops with 10 tools: live quizzes, polls, word games, visual puzzles and QR resource sharing.

records.name: Hotel Lobby AI Video
records.tagline: Two photos into a synchronized AI duo clip in a minute.
records.description: Hotel Lobby AI Video turns two uploaded photos into a synchronized two-person Hotel Lobby performance. Choose a 15 or 30 second template and the tool applies preset motion, camera timing, 4:3 framing, 720p output and generated audio. Built for creators publishing a consistent duo video series. Try it live at https://hotellobbyaivideo.online/

records.name: JobSignal
records.tagline: Your best job matches, scored and explained, every day
records.description: JobSignal is a Chrome extension that hunts the job market around the clock, scores every fresh posting against your CV with AI (0 to 100, with the reasons), and emails you the ones worth applying to. Open a posting on any job site and see your score right on the page. Each match comes with a game plan: why it fits, the gaps, a message to the recruiter. Free for 48 hours, no card. Students stay free, others $4.99 or $7.99 a week. Read-only: never auto-applies, never sells your data.

records.name: LifeWell
records.tagline: People, memories and everyday life, connected
records.description: Bring the people, moments and everyday details of your life together. • Keep notes about the people who matter • Give memories a date, caption, place and people • Organise notes, appointments and everyday records • Choose trackers, journal and wellbeing tools • Use selected sharing links with expiry controls Start small on web or Android: one person, one memory, one record. LifeWell records what you enter; it is not a medical service.

records.name: Memo Notepad Online

records.tagline: Enterprise AI Agents and ERP Agents
records.description: Enterprise AI agents: shared, governed AI capability that works inside ERPNext, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and other enterprise platforms, and evolves continuously across business domains.

records.name: AI Video Download
records.tagline: Turn a TXT link list into a batch of MP4 downloads
records.description: Import a TXT file or paste up to 10 links to prepare MP4 files, with progress for each item. Save ready files individually. Single-link MP3 is also available. Free, with no site account required. For videos you have permission to save.

records.name: 에브리박스
records.tagline: Free online tools: PDF, images & QR codes. No sign-u.
records.description: Everybox is a free online toolbox with 20+ everyday utilities — no sign-up, no downloads. What you get: · PDF: merge, split, compress, edit, sign, JPG-to-PDF, PDF-to-Word · Images: compress, background remover, HEIC-to-JPG, image editor · Barcode & QR code generator · GIF maker from video · Digital stamp & signature creator · Keyword research tool · Currency exchange calculator · Lotto & tarot 100% free. No watermarks, no file size limits, no premium tiers.

records.name: Aither
records.tagline: AI customer support that resolves tickets
records.description: Aither is an AI support agent that reads your policies, takes action in your systems and closes tickets end to end, handing the hard ones to your team with the work already done.

records.name: EmplAI HRMS
records.tagline: Human Resource Management Software
records.description: Emplai HRMS is a comprehensive human resource management solution designed to simplify and streamline HR operations. It helps businesses manage employee information, attendance, leave, payroll, and HR workflows in one place. By reducing manual tasks and improving data visibility, Emplai HRMS enables HR teams to save time, improve efficiency, and focus on employee engagement and business growth.

records.name: CASE
records.tagline: SaaS para abogados y estudios jurídicos argentinos
records.description: SaaS para abogados y estudios jurídicos argentinos. Gestión de expedientes, documentos y chat IA con contexto del caso.

records.name: GPU Rated
records.tagline: Benchmark & Compare High-Performance GPU Cloud & AI Clusters
records.description: Independent Sysbench v1.0 CPU single & multi-core runs, 4K fio random NVMe IOPS, and 10Gbps–400Gbps network throughput audits. Zero paid placements, zero affiliate bias — just raw execution data across 70+ hosting providers.

records.name: Taskodoro
records.tagline: Your comfort planner
records.description: For a few months, I've had an idea. What is the most recreated app in the world? A todo app. What if we push it to the extreme with some quirky features... and give it a good, aesthetics-focused UI centered on comfort? Which eventually became this free & open-source project.
